integrity: Analytic proof with standalone standard-library reproducibility checks; conditional Poisson identities and coupling proofs are mathematical rather than inferred from finite simulation.
scientific_limitations: Finite-activity homogeneous Poisson counting paths on [0,1], one evaluation per equal cell; mean-square error is unconditional over both path and design. Paired result requires even n. Specialization of standard Poisson random-measure tools and unverified full publication precedence remain limitations. No claim of optimality among deterministic or arbitrary-function quadrature methods.
title: Exact coupling-dependent variance and error laws for Poisson-path quadrature
